panel.summary: Deviation is broader than the issue: ANY lone single-dash setext underline stops being a heading, including top-level `Heading\n-` outside any list. The issue (#517) and the task's acceptance criteria only describe the nested-empty-bullet case; the guard could have been scoped to lines inside/indented under a list. It is documented as deliberate in docs/design/notes/notes.md:293-299, so this is a scope/taste call rather than a hard violation, but it silently changes a valid CommonMark construct the issue never mentioned.
panel.evidence: const isLoneDash = marker === DASH && runLength === 1; — applied unconditionally in the replacement lheading rule, with no check that the line participates in a list context.
